preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The input string must not be empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'PO~ ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string must only contain the characters 'P', 'O', '~', and space.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of deaf rats as a string.
The count of deaf rats must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: count_deaf_rats(s) == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) if s[i:i+2] == '~O' and 'P' in s[i+2:])
postconditions.description: The count of deaf rats must match the number of '~O' sequences before the Pied Piper.
